reverification_note: Every unverified-candidate from the four recons was re-searched online this pass. RESULT: (1) LinearLayout — PROMOTED to verified: a formal paper now exists (arXiv:2505.23819, v5 2026-03, authors incl. Adam Goucher & Phil Tillet) that the recon predates. (2) TritonAffinityOpt polyhedral lineage — the candidate root (Pluto, Bondhugula PLDI'08, DOI 10.1145/1375581.1375595) IS a real verifiable paper, but the Triton-ascend source cites NO reference; attribution stays editorial/inferential → kept unverified (attribution, not existence). (3) AscendNPU-IR/BiSheng/CANN/HIVM/HFusion — re-searched, NO dedicated IR-design academic paper exists (only Huawei systems/serving papers e.g. CloudMatrix384 2506.12708, unrelated to the IR) → kept unverified. (4) Autotuner — confirmed implements NO published algorithm (empirical grid search) → no paper, grounding none. Two editorial (uncited-in-source) lineage papers were verified-to-exist and recorded honestly: online-softmax (Milakov & Gimelshein, arXiv:1805.02867) folded into the FlashAttention primer, and Stream-K (Osama et al., arXiv:2301.03598) as optional citation for persistent-matmul. No citation fabricated.
